We are launching home delivery for our bakery in Springfield in November. Write a marketing plan for the first three months.
The total budget is 3000 EUR including any paid ads. Show which channels we use, what each costs and why.
Give a week-by-week calendar for the first month and a month-by-month plan after that.
Say how we will count orders that came from each channel.
Everything customers see must exist in English and Spanish.
